Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The urine results show significant leukocyturia, proteinuria, hematuria, nitrites, and abundant bacteria, with urine culture confirming >100,000 CFU/mL Escherichia coli. These findings are highly suggestive of a urinary tract infection, likely acute cystitis or possibly pyelonephritis. Low specific gravity may reflect dilute urine. Prompt clinical evaluation and appropriate antibiotic therapy are recommended.
